svg.title: Purple Panel
svg.desc: Interpretive vector study after the viewed reference. Approximate geometry; framing, wall, shadows and paint texture omitted. January 2024 photographed Saint Louis galleryvisit explicitly identifies Purple Panel (1988). Purple triangular front face has slightly bowed upper edge, long left diagonal, near-vertical right edge. Exposed wooden thickness and wall shadows omitted. Photograph oblique: observed proportions only, despite known square physical bounding dimensions.
